method: Implementation-only estimates of source-derived EMM mechanics implemented in mod/engine. Gameplay verification is separately tracked and does not affect percent or block estimate updates. Count neither unintegrated scaffolding nor unimplemented/approximate features as faithful. Scores remain subjective (often ±5–10 percentage points or more); in-game acceptance deferred until health is near-complete.

systems.title: City health and disease
gameplayConfirmed: 2026-10-26 player screenshot: Herbalist was advertised as +1 Food in old mod; presentation bug confirmed, not a successful health test.
2026-10-26 screenshot: city health totals display (3/2, net +1), but icon rendered as an empty white square and Herbalist displayed text-only health; UI regression confirmed.
2026-10-26 user reports 'Health seems to be working' following corrected health UI APK; broad smoke test only, not confirmation of every formula, building or resource.
systems.verification: Source-informed reusable event world actions: spawn matching class unit with free promotions, rollback on placement failure; conditional named-tile-improvement removal; saved unit/tile selection across game clones. War Games disband/XP outcomes and source-ac; Winds from Hell Windmill destruction; Doviello Necro-Cannibalism Warrior-class unit and native Cannibalize on-kill +10 HP effect. CI ruleset validation passed, Kotlin engine compilation passed; Android packaging/player tests pending. In-game checks deliberately deferred; scores concern source implementation completeness only.
systems.remainingDifferences: 10/23 EMM Armageddon-related event trigger families scheduled with restricted choices. Generic spawn helper currently only exposed for Doviello Necro-Cannibalism; other summons and their source promotions not yet ported. Windmill Machinery tech extra yields missing. Original EMM living-unit filter in War Games approximated, full Civ IV event random selection/dynamic prerequisites/AI choices and pending event in-game save/load testing missing. Provisional raw Blight/Pestilence unit damage exists as an optional post-patcher, but full typed Death damage, source-derived bMechanized/bNotAlive living classification now implemented in generated epidemic handler; translated unit-name parity and full promotion availability still require static audit, build integration proof and remaining source mechanics are outstanding.
systems.updatedBy: 2026-10-27: source-derived CvUnit living counter, dynamic race promotions; typed Death damage pending

systems.title: Armageddon Counter
systems.verification: Implementation review only: persisted global AC 0–100, source-linked increment/decrement hooks, one-time Blight/Pestilence thresholds, a typed event catalog, restricted native event-choice pipeline, and saved event targets. Static CI/build evidence exists for earlier slices; no in-game verification required for this estimate.
systems.remainingDifferences: Many original AC inputs, effects and special events unimplemented; thirteen of twenty-three catalogued Armageddon-related event families not playable, existing families have gated choices. Full catastrophe effects, typed Death damage, living-unit classification, probability/AI/source timing parity and Hell terrain remain incomplete. Provisional epidemic damage post-patcher is present but not yet demonstrated in successful Android build.
